judgment.actual_four_roots_need_pipe_while: No unavoidable case found at the current design-action granularity.
judgment.universal_claim: Not established; this does not prove every well-defined operator can eliminate while.
real_feedback_found: QSA CAS return values drive local probing.
QSA ticket publication/acknowledgement drives legitimate cross-role continuation.
Optional decode BLASST publishes data-dependent selection without changing the finite tile domain.
critical_conditions: Dynamic for(t) must use actual pre-existing work_schedule assignment, with claim/post/ack/terminal actions still explicit.
No-work/terminal payload absence does not delete protocol events.
Real capacity bounds are distinct from arbitrary caps and primitive waiting has no proven finite retry count.

loop_groups.title: FA4 hd256 root 外层工作 guard
loop_groups.predicate_source: Static scheduler _is_first_block; root dispatch excludes flatten/persistent.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: advance_to_next_work clears _is_first_block. Each admitted root worktile is handled once.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: No outer role loop is needed for one preassigned worktile. Existing internal finite for domains remain.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Does not describe persistent or CLC settings in the same implementation file.

loop_groups.title: FA4 dense/paged KV 数学有限遍历
loop_groups.predicate_source: Trip start/count is computed from sequence lengths, causal/window bounds and split metadata.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: The next input KV block is consumed on every iteration; result values never extend the trip range.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Natural for over ordered KV blocks. Preserve peeled first/final products, stats acknowledgement, final sums and output-stage lifetimes.
loop_groups.extra_state: No stopping latch; existing online max/sum and ring cursors are algorithmic state.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: No full GPU timing, numerics or waiting graph proof; conditional correction may skip payload but must retain ownership return.

loop_groups.title: FA4 static persistent 与 CLC 工作领取
loop_groups.predicate_source: Static mode tests linear index against fixed work count. CLC tests the validity bit returned by an actual hardware work response.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Static indices advance by worker stride. CLC consumes one actual returned worktile and exits on the first invalid response; no further failed-query retry appears in these loops.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Static or allowed dynamic for(t), with explicit claim/response handoffs and final drain. The for header cannot perform scheduling actions.
loop_groups.extra_state: No synthetic local-success round domain. Preserve real scheduler state and phases.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: CLC device implementation is imported from CUTLASS and not frozen here; no fairness or full hardware termination proof.

loop_groups.title: FA4 general SM100 稀疏列表与空工作协议
loop_groups.predicate_source: Masked/full counts and ordered block-index arrays are supplied metadata. Empty means the split/subtile-adjusted total count is zero.
body_actions: Reverse masked list then reverse full list
For nonempty blocks: K/V, QK, probabilities and PV
For empty tiles: acquire stats slot, synthetic empty notification, correction rendezvous/release, zero output
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: List indices move across fixed metadata-defined extents. Empty work still advances stats/epilogue handshakes, but not P/O-MMA events.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: for over actual worktiles, finite sparse block for and explicit if(Empty). Filtering empty worktiles out of t is incorrect.
loop_groups.extra_state: Existing ring phase state must be retained; no new continuation latch is required.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Only selected vendor branch mechanisms were read. Empty-path report excerpt is not a complete role migration or full waiting proof.

loop_groups.title: FA4 varlen work-coordinate 分组搜索
loop_groups.predicate_source: group_end_tile <= next_tile_idx, based on per-batch query lengths and warp prefix sums.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Batch index strictly advances by 31; at batch_idx >= B, group_end_tile becomes next_tile_idx+1. At most ceil(B/31) subsequent iterations, including terminal handling.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: for over real batch groups with a guard retaining the found state; must preserve invalid-coordinate sentinel. Extra false checks can remain.
loop_groups.extra_state: Current batch/prefix state suffices; a separate sticky stop latch is unnecessary if the guarded state stops changing.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Coordinate helper reads are internal; it is not an already exposed multi-role action pipeline.

loop_groups.title: FA4 归约与 prefix binary search 辅助算法
body_actions: Read cu_tensor[mid+1] and shrink search interval
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Reduction halves offset. Binary search strictly shrinks nonnegative interval; a real logarithmic upper bound exists.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Fixed reduction stages, or bounded for plus if(lo<hi) for search. The latter is less natural at implementation level and retains tail tests.
loop_groups.extra_state: Original offset / lo / hi state; no additional stop latch.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Reduction helper has no call found in frozen package. Binary search callers are non-root MLA and sparse-metadata code.

loop_groups.title: FA4 显式 Python/PTX 原语等待

evidence.note: actual root imports cutlass.utils.blackwell_helpers, not the local helper with the same basename

loop_groups.predicate_source: Acquire-loaded flag equals expected value, or mbarrier.try_wait parity returns success.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Exit depends on external participant notification. No useful finite attempt count is established; PTX 10000000 is a wait hint, not a total retry cap.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Keep await/acquire as a primitive contract. Do not invent a retry domain or cap as successful completion.
loop_groups.extra_state: Underlying primitive state is not expanded into pipe rounds.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: These local wait helpers are not evidence that root explicitly runs these exact loops; external CUTLASS lowering was not inspected.

loop_groups.title: FA4 主机缓存文件锁
loop_groups.predicate_source: time.monotonic() < deadline, with break on successful flock.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Success breaks; deadline raises RuntimeError. No GPU worktile action is involved.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Outside tile_pipeline. Timeout must not be recast as normal successful loop completion.
loop_groups.extra_state: Host acquired flag exists in source.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: This is a host cold-path mechanism, not a model of GPU role feedback.

loop_groups.title: GDN 六 role 固定步长工作循环
loop_groups.predicate_source: Current linear tile index < total_tiles. M64 sets total_tiles=2*B*HV.
body_actions: Load and store each worktile state
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Each role increments the same preassigned linear sequence by resident CTA count; fixed finite total.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: for(t) over that preassigned sequence, preserving initialization/final-state work and worker tails; no implicit inter-worktile drain.
loop_groups.extra_state: None beyond existing ring cursors and scheduler indices.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Readable source is a build input; actual solution.py has the same role loops in minified form. This is one mechanism, not two byte-identical copies.

loop_groups.title: GDN chunk 递推、padding 与 scalar lookahead
loop_groups.predicate_source: Np=2*ceil(L_b/128) from Cu32, pair count=Np/2; lookahead guard j+4<Np.
body_actions: Output store including no-payload padded rounds
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Every iteration advances a prescribed input chunk. Carried numeric S/max state does not choose whether another chunk exists.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Natural ordered for domains and front/main/tail ranges. Preserve padded protocol events and all per-worktile state boundaries.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Normal root has positive sequence lengths; generalized empty-sequence behavior was not used to justify root equivalence.

loop_groups.title: GDN 层级逆与固定 pivot
loop_groups.predicate_source: N=8 pivot coordinates and explicit 8→16→32→64 hierarchy; no convergence predicate.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Fixed finite matrix dimensions and hierarchy.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Existing action contract retains finite internal work; explicit phase for is possible if intentionally refining granularity, while is unnecessary.
loop_groups.extra_state: Matrix state is algorithmic; no stop latch.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Function boundary crosses inverse/publication action boundary, so function names alone cannot identify pipe actions.

loop_groups.title: GDN 未调用 legacy MMA issuer 的 while
loop_groups.predicate_source: work.is_valid_tile from the same strided GDNTileScheduler.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Source uses the same fixed stride and finite padded chunk range.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Not needed for actual-root conclusion; no call to mma_issuer_warp found in frozen package.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Do not count the definition or its minified copy as additional root roles.

loop_groups.title: Decode KV 序列与 split 合并
loop_groups.predicate_source: iters_s from sequence length, tile width and work_splits; causal mask ranges are metadata-derived.
body_actions: Load and accumulate nominal partial splits
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Natural finite input/split domains. try_wait tokens feed wait_and_advance rather than causing role-body retries.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: for plus first/last/empty if; retain N_r=0/1 special stats and empty-slot retirement.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: No Python while/break exists in this frozen family. External CUTLASS primitive implementations are not frozen.

loop_groups.title: Decode BLASST 已发布 skip predicate
loop_groups.predicate_source: Score maximum versus prior reference and configured threshold; published warpgroup keep_tile flag.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Traversal always moves to the next original sequence tile; false keep is not permanent termination.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: for over all original tiles plus explicit flag publish/wait and if(keep_tile). Do not filter the input domain to only kept tiles before computing it.
loop_groups.extra_state: Original keep state and phases already exist; no sticky termination latch.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Root compiles threshold=None. Numeric validity of the approximate optional branch not proved.

loop_groups.title: QSA CAS / linear probing
loop_groups.predicate_source: not placed; placed becomes true only after CAS sees empty or matching key and membership OR completes.
body_actions: Atomic OR low/high membership on success
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Legal root has at most MaxE=5130 distinct group keys, H=16384, no deletions or key overwrites. Failed probes advance to distinct successive slots; a full H-slot cycle cannot fail. Requires normal primitive execution progress, not a wall-clock bound.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Current pipe keeps Hash as one action. At thread-algorithm level a genuine H-slot candidate for with if(not placed) preserves memory-operation sequence under matched linearizations; extra inactive checks remain.
loop_groups.extra_state: placed already exists. No additional latch is needed; do not invent a success-round domain.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: No hardware trace or bitwise numerical equivalence of compiled rewrites claimed. Capacity proof depends on legal quad packing; arbitrary mixed-group fallback needs a new capacity/output-space audit.

loop_groups.title: QSA terminal-ticket 多角色协议
loop_groups.predicate_source: Scheduler term comes from already claimed u>=total_units after all unit_taken acknowledgements. Consumers continue according to the published u.
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: W=820 logical work units are fixed; claims yield unique monotonically increasing tickets relative to the launch base. Under serialized eager calls and progress, each CTA consumes one terminal and global total claims=W+P.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Dynamic for(t) is justified by existing actual work assignment, not an invented local feedback domain. Preserve first claim/ack outside and Next(t)/ack inside; m valid worktiles produce m+1 claims/acks in either version.
loop_groups.extra_state: No extra loop latch beyond existing ticket and phase state. For header performs no atomic/read/wait/notify.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Conditioned on current grammar allowing actual dynamic worktile sequences. No complete hardware fairness or deadlock proof. Source terminal qready remains even when terminal Q payload is skipped; baseline no-op wording is incomplete.

loop_groups.title: QSA union tile 与条件 rescale
loop_groups.predicate_source: N=ceil(Count/etile) from completed preprocess. Vote depends on current/prior max but only controls rescale.
body_actions: Read scores and exchange half maxima
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: All N union tiles are traversed; neither score vote nor rescale result changes N.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: for over original union tiles, if for true protocol choice; preserve P-ready and prior-PV/output ownership boundaries.
loop_groups.extra_state: Online state and cumulative gt continue as in source; no termination latch.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Approximation, padded-row vote effects and all numerical error bounds remain outside this control investigation.

body_actions: Not individually audited in this report
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: No universal progress proof asserted from the spelling of the predicate.
loop_groups.for_if_alternative: Excluded from actual-root necessity claim; exact locations retained in inventory.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Inventory only; does not claim all such vendor loops can be removed.

loop_groups.title: FA4 backward iter_count loops
loop_groups.predicate_source: iter_count > 0 in three backward helper bodies.
body_actions: Representative load body processes one iteration then decrements count; MMA/compute locations retained without full reread
loop_groups.progress_and_exit: Representative source decrements iter_count each round; full backward lifecycle not proved.
loop_groups.evidence_limits: Do not count backward load/MMA/compute occurrences as root mechanisms.
